newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, ELECT TO BAT V SRI LANKA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, ELECT TO BAT V SRI LANKA.

text.p: India won the toss and elected to
bat in the 50-overs a side day-night cricket match against Sri
Lanka in the four-nation Independence Cup on Saturday.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul
Dravid, Vinod Kambli, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia,
Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla.
Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya,
Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda De Silva, Hashan
Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana), Kumara Dharmasena, Chaminda
Vaas, Sajeeva De Silva, Muthiah Muralitharan
